fields.System.Title: RET-303 — Require inspection before disposition
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want disposition blocked until an inspection exists, so
that nothing returns to sale without having been examined.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a return line with no inspection record, then every disposition action is
  • rejected.
  • - Given the rule, then it is enforced in the service layer so no client can bypass it.
  • - Given a partly inspected line, then only the inspected quantity can be dispositioned.
  • - Given an inspector, then their pass rate is reportable — an inspector passing 100% is
  • not inspecting.
  • - Given a released-to-available transition, then it requires the inspection ID, matching
  • [INV-402](../INV/INV-402-release-from-quarantine.md).

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | returns, inventory |
| Tables | inspection, disposition |
| Risks | Damaged stock restocked ([doc 09 §8.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); rubber-stamping ([doc 09 §8.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
